name: @noxlabs/confidential-transfers-sdk
description: SDK for EVM ERC20 Confidential Transfers
author: Nox Labs

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && npm run update && tsup src/index.ts --format cjs,esm --dts && mkdir -p dist/artifacts && cp -R src/artifacts/proofs-helpers dist/artifacts/proofs-helpers && cp -R src/artifacts/abi dist/artifacts/abi
scripts.update: rm -rf src/artifacts/abi && mkdir -p src/artifacts/abi && npm run update:abi:json && npm run update:abi:ts && npm run update:typechain
scripts.update:typechain: rm -rf src/artifacts/typechain && mkdir -p src/artifacts/typechain && mkdir -p src/artifacts/typechain/src && cp ../../out/hardhat/typechain/src/ConfidentialTransfers.ts src/artifacts/typechain/src/ && cp ../../out/hardhat/typechain/src/ConfidentialOFT.ts src/artifacts/typechain/src/ && cp ../../out/hardhat/typechain/common.ts src/artifacts/typechain/ && mkdir -p src/artifacts/typechain/test/utils/mock && cp ../../out/hardhat/typechain/test/utils/mock/MockERC20.ts src/artifacts/typechain/test/utils/mock/ && cp ../../out/hardhat/typechain/test/utils/mock/MockConfidentialOFT.ts src/artifacts/typechain/test/utils/mock/
scripts.update:abi:json: node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const artifact=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("../../out/foundry/ConfidentialTransfers.sol/ConfidentialTransfers.json", "utf8")); fs.writeFileSync("src/artifacts/abi/ConfidentialTransfers.json", JSON.stringify(artifact.abi, null, 2)); const artifactOFT=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("../../out/foundry/ConfidentialOFT.sol/ConfidentialOFT.json", "utf8")); fs.writeFileSync("src/artifacts/abi/ConfidentialOFT.json", JSON.stringify(artifactOFT.abi, null, 2));'
scripts.update:abi:ts:
node -e 'const fs=require("fs"); const abi=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("src/artifacts/abi/ConfidentialTransfers.json", "utf8")); const content=`export const confidentialTransfersAbi = ${JSON.stringify(abi, null, 2)} as const

export type ConfidentialTransfersAbi = typeof confidentialTransfersAbi
`; fs.writeFileSync("src/artifacts/abi/ConfidentialTransfers.ts", content); const abiOFT=JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync("src/artifacts/abi/ConfidentialOFT.json", "utf8")); const contentOFT=`export const confidentialOFTAbi = ${JSON.stringify(abiOFT, null, 2)} as const

export type ConfidentialOFTAbi = typeof confidentialOFTAbi
`; fs.writeFileSync("src/artifacts/abi/ConfidentialOFT.ts", contentOFT);'
